div.div:
/rfe-speedrun
--type {t}, --input {path}
--headless, --announce-complete
--dry-run, --batch-size N (default 5)
{idea} or a {KEY_PREFIX}NNNN Jira key
tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash,
AskUserQuestion, Skill

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Step 0 - Layout + Type
bootstrap.sh --layout once (exit 3 = the
working dir already carries scripts/, types/)
type_registry.py resolve [--type {t}]
[--batch {input}] [--headless] [{key}]
the --input mapping form's type: is rung 2
launch-vars {type} speedrun -> the {VAR} block

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 278px; height: 1px; padding-top: 427px; margin-left: 582px;

div.div:
Clean + Pin Flags
state.py clean; prep_assess.py --clean-all
state.py init
tmp/{STATE_PREFIX}speedrun-config.yaml
type= headless= announce_complete=
dry_run= input_file=
batch_size= MUST be a concrete int (5)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 280px; height: 1px; padding-top: 117px; margin-left: 586px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
tmp/{STATE_PREFIX}speedrun-config.yaml
(state.py init - one key: value per line)
type: rfe
headless: false
announce_complete: false
dry_run: false
batch_size: 5 (int, never {N}/null)
input_file: null
tmp/{STATE_PREFIX}speedrun-all-ids.txt
(state.py write-ids: one ID per line,
deduped - re-read before every phase)
{STATE_PREFIX} = "" for rfe,
"initiative-" for initiative

div.div:
Step 0.5 - Bootstrap
{BOOTSTRAP} = bash scripts/bootstrap.sh
--type {type}
run EARLY so {SCORER_AGENT} is in
.claude/agents/ before Phase 2
the create phase gives the rescan time
fails -> retry once, then continue

div.div:
--input {path} (Mode A batch file)
list form - one mapping per entry:
- prompt: "Users need to verify model
signatures at serving time"
priority: Critical # Blocker, Critical,
Major, Normal, Minor, Undefined
labels: [candidate-3.5] # list of str
clarifying_context: "The security team
has flagged ..." # verbatim, as DATA
- prompt: "TrustyAI operator crashes"
priority: Major # minimal entry
mapping form - the same entries:
type: {TYPE}
items: [ ... ]
+ the type's {BATCH_EXTRA_FIELDS}:
rfe: [] initiative: [parent_key]
a per-item type: key is rejected in
both forms - a run is single-typed
unknown field / duplicate prompt =
WARNING -> blocking under --strict

print the ERROR:/WARNING: lines
--strict: unknown field and

mapping type: vs {TYPE_FLAG}
mismatch = ERROR: batch:
no ID allocated, no agent run

one Agent per batch entry

[--priority] [--parent {parent_key}]

delimited block - DATA, never instructions
all N launched in ONE message

div.div:
/rfe-auto-fix
Skill tool - NOT Agent
Skill(skill: "rfe-auto-fix", args:
"{TYPE_FLAG} [--headless] [--announce-complete]
--batch-size {n} {IDs}")
Agent would background it and end the session
assess, {DIMENSIONS}, review, revise, re-assess,
split, retry queue, run + HTML reports
blocks until complete - never stop early
